blocks.h2: How to Make Your Disposal Last
blocks.body: Run cold water before, during and after grinding. Feed food in a little at a time instead of all at once. Keep grease, fibrous peels, pasta and rice out. They either coat the pipe or swell into a paste. Grind a few ice cubes once in a while to clean the chamber. Most disposals last about 8 to 12 years. When one starts leaking from the body, it's time for a new unit, not a repair.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a Disposal Job
blocks.body: A straight replacement is quick. Changes to the drain, a new outlet or a dishwasher connection can add time. If the kitchen drain is partly clogged, it should be cleared first. We check and quote one flat price.

blocks.h2: Garbage Disposal Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: My disposal hums. What should I do?
items.preview: Turn it off. It's probably jammed.
items.answer: Turn it off. Try the reset button and the hex key under the unit. If it won't turn, call us.

items.q: Should I repair or replace it?
items.preview: If it leaks from the body or is old, replace it.
items.answer: If the body leaks or it's more than about 10 years old, replacing it usually makes more sense.

items.q: Why does my dishwasher back up into the sink?
items.preview: The disposal or drain is clogged.
items.answer: Usually a clogged disposal or drain line.

items.q: Can you install a disposal I bought?
items.answer: Yes, if it fits the sink and the electrical is in place.

items.q: What size disposal do I need?
items.answer: For most homes, 1/2 or 3/4 horsepower. Bigger households and heavy cooks benefit from 3/4.
Usually food trapped under the rubber splash guard. Cleaning it often solves the smell.

items.q: How long does a disposal installation take?
items.answer: Usually about an hour or two for a straight replacement.

items.q: How much does garbage disposal repair cost in Hanover Park?
items.preview: It depends on the unit. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the unit and connections. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
